title: Malware Mayhem
instructions: A sophisticated malware campaign is hitting the Phalanx Cyber Academy Gaming Championship. Investigate the infected system, identify the real threats, and avoid false positives.

messages.text: Championship systems are down. Open the case file, work the exhibits, and render your call.

notify.text: The scan names the payload. Check the process list for what spawned it.
notify.speaker: instructor

notify.text: Look for the parent process - payloads rarely run alone.
notify.speaker: instructor

briefing.narrative: A sophisticated malware campaign is hitting the Phalanx Cyber Academy Gaming Championship. Multiple team systems are compromised by malware disguised as 'ProGamer Boost v2.1' - a fake performance enhancement tool. You are the lead incident responder. The tournament broadcast is in 2 minutes. Open the Process Monitor and Malware Scanner to find the evidence, then decide which processes to terminate and which files to quarantine.
briefing.speaker: instructor

process_decision.narrative: You have reviewed the process list. Some processes are clearly malicious, but several are legitimate system tools that only look suspicious. What is your next move?
process_decision.speaker: instructor

choices.feedback: Correct. You terminated the malicious processes without harming legitimate software.
Too aggressive. Legitimate tools like the NVIDIA control panel and tournament updater were false positives.
Delay is dangerous. The malware continues to mine, steal credentials, and spread.

quarantine_prompt.narrative: With the malicious processes stopped, you now need to remove the malware files. Open the Malware Scanner to see the scan results.
quarantine_prompt.speaker: instructor

quarantine_decision.narrative: The scan results are in. Five real malware files and five false positives are flagged. Choose which files to quarantine.
quarantine_decision.speaker: instructor

choices.text: Quarantine only the 5 confirmed malware files
choices.feedback: Correct. You removed the malware while leaving legitimate software untouched.
False positives quarantined. Important tools like the antivirus and streaming assistant were disrupted.

choices.text: Ignore the scan and move on
choices.feedback: The malware files remain on the system and can re-launch when the machine restarts.

complete.narrative: Incident response complete. The tournament systems are clean and the broadcast can go on.
complete.speaker: instructor

files.content:

[TRUSTED] antivirus_service.exe - Built-in antivirus
[TRUSTED] game_client.exe - Official tournament game client

[MALICIOUS] progamer_boost_v21.exe - Fake gaming tool, trojan dropper

Hint: Terminate only the five entries marked [MALICIOUS].
